audits.text:
## a3c76f931ce5

Actionable control-surface defect reproduced on exact source `4ad868fb1638d59365bc0939e77a78eb0ae626ed8503db32979cb9329cfa6938`.

- `anchor_corner=False` and `anchor_corner=True` produce byte-identical grids under fixed seed and other controls.
- `asymmetry_force=False` and `asymmetry_force=True` are likewise byte-identical.
- Explicit `palette_size=1` is byte-identical to omitting the axis.
- `palette_kind` never changes the realized palette (always `[0, 3]` in the fixed probe). It changes hole geometry for 19 of 32 checked seeds only because `_build_palette()` shuffles an unused list with the shared layout RNG before `_pick_hole_pos()` consumes that RNG.

This makes three advertised axes dead and a fourth misdirected: its name/documentation claim palette control, but its only observable effect is unrelated geometry. A caller can therefore record an accepted override without receiving the advertised semantic variation.

Reproduction:

```sh
python3 WORK/checks/audit/a3c76f931ce5/probe.py > WORK/checks/audit/a3c76f931ce5/probe.json
```

Evidence: `checks/audit/a3c76f931ce5/probe.py` and `checks/audit/a3c76f931ce5/probe.json`.

No files under `repo/generators/a3c76f931ce5/` were edited; this audit is findings-only.
